name: Momosaki Shizuku
source:
A first-year student at Seirei Academy, she serves as the representative of both the Ramen Club and the Oratorical Society.

She met Souta this spring under certain circumstances, and they maintain a comfortable, balanced distance in their relationship. An extreme liberal arts type, she dislikes sports and has nothing to do with typical student party culture. Simply put, she has poor communication skills, but because she is capable and poised, she doesn't come across as self-deprecating. While she rarely shows her emotions, she handles everything flawlessly, and Souta is completely wrapped around her finger.

Unlike Koharu, she isn't overly doting, but she casually looks out for him in subtle ways, and Souta finds a comforting ease in their dynamic. Her otaku traits are low, and she looks with a cold, unimpressed eye at everyone making a fuss over witches and magic—yet...?

She cannot sum up her favorite ramen in a single word. Her recent craze is shio (salt).

Favorite things: Ramen, cleaning, protagonist's care
Disliked things: Exercise, perfect tension, summer

[Translated from the [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/sprinkle/character/chara4.php#chara-main]official website[/url]]
